HAT-4D：通过人机协作提升单目视频以实现 4D 多对象交互HAT-4D: Lifting Monocular Video for 4D Multi-Object Interactions via Human-Agent Collaboration

Jiaxin Li *    Yuxiang Wu *    Zhenkai Zhang    Xinrui Shi    Haoyuan Wang    Yichen Zhao ‡\ddagger    Su Linxiang ‡\ddagger    Chenyang Yu    Mingyu Zhang    Yifan Ding    Boran Wen    Li Zhang    Ruiyang Liu    Yong-Lu Li †\dagger
摘要Abstract

从大量野外单目视频中提取动态 4D 对象交互，为扩展 Embodied AI 和训练 VLA 提供了高效的数据收集途径。 然而，现有的单目 4D 重建方法主要关注孤立的对象，在多对象交互中固有的严重遮挡和复杂动态下往往会失败。 为了弥补这一差距，我们建议Extracting dynamic 4D object interactions from massive, in-the-wild monocular videos offers a highly efficient data collection pathway for scaling Embodied AI and training VLAs. However, existing monocular 4D reconstruction methods primarily focus on isolated objects, often failing under the severe occlusions and complex dynamics inherent in multi-object interactions. To bridge this gap, we proposeHAT-4D，第一个, the first代理框架agentic framework旨在从单个视频中重建多个对象的 3D 几何、时间动态和物理交互。 通过将 VLM 与多级集成designed to reconstruct the 3D geometry, temporal dynamics, and physical interactions of multiple objects from a single video. By integrating VLMs with a multi-level人在回路human-in-the-loop通过反馈机制，HAT-4D 可以有效解决 3D 生成和 4D 传播期间的深度模糊性和交互引起的遮挡，从而在不依赖昂贵的多摄像头设备的情况下产生物理上合理的资产。 作为一个可扩展的数据引擎，HAT-4D 有助于创建feedback mechanism, HAT-4D efficiently resolves depth ambiguities and interaction-induced occlusions during 3D generation and 4D propagation, yielding physically plausible assets without relying on expensive multi-camera rigs. As a scalable data engine, HAT-4D facilitates the creation ofMVOIK-4D，单眼 4D 交互重建的开放世界基准，伴随着专注于物理合理性和时间一致性的新颖的多维评估协议。 大量实验表明 HAT-4D 在大多数评估指标上实现 SOTA 性能， 同时保持有竞争力的语义一致性。 消融研究表明，引入少量 人类反馈改善了交互重建。 此外，HAT-4D 产生的数据在用于微调时有效提高了基线性能。 我们的数据和代码可在, an open-world benchmark for monocular 4D interaction reconstruction, accompanied by a novel multi-dimensional evaluation protocol focused on physical plausibility and temporal consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HAT-4D achieves SOTA performance on most evaluation metrics, while maintaining competitive semantic alignment. Ablation studies show that introducing a small amount of human feedback improves interaction reconstruction. Moreover, the data produced by HAT-4D effectively improves baseline performance when used for finetuning. Our data and code are available atproject webpage.

1 简介Introduction

在时空相干的 4D 框架内理解和重建物理上合理的对象交互的能力对于众多下游应用程序至关重要，例如填充沉浸式虚拟环境The ability to understand and reconstruct physically plausible object interactions within a spatio-temporally coherent 4D frame is essential for numerous downstream applications, such as populating immersive virtual environments[li2025genhoigeneralizingtextdriven4d, ji2025immersivehumanxinteractionrealtime]，并训练机器人感知, and training robotic perception[chen2025m]、理解, understanding[zhang2026ipr, li2023beyond]和操纵, and manipulation[hou20254dvisualpretrainingrobot, zeng2024learningmanipulationpredictinginteraction, wang2026great]。 由于单目视频是现实世界对象交互最丰富、最容易获取的来源，因此将这些 2D 观察提升为动态 4D 多对象交互已成为该研究的中心目标. Since monocular video serves as the most abundant and accessible source of real-world object interactions, lifting these 2D observations into dynamic 4D multi-object interactions has emerged as a central objective for the research[l4gm, fb4d, gvfdiffusion]。然而，这种重建从根本上来说是一个不适定问题，需要解开复杂的、不断变化的空间关系，解决严重的相互遮挡，并在整个序列中维持严格的时空一致性。. However, this reconstruction is a fundamentally ill-posed problem, requiring the disentanglement of complex, evolving spatial relationships, the resolution of heavy mutual occlusions, and the maintenance of strict spatio-temporal consistency across the sequence.

现有的获取 4D 对象交互数据的方法通常分为两个极端。一方面，硬件密集型方法Existing approaches to acquiring 4D object interaction data generally fall into two extremes. On the one hand, hardware-intensive approaches[lu2024diva, chen20254dslomo]依赖于大规模、同步的多摄像头设备。虽然它们以高质量的动态捕捉无遮挡的物体，但这些系统非常昂贵，严格限制在受控的工作室环境中，并且从根本上无法扩展用于开放世界的数据收集。 另一方面，最近的生成方法试图通过利用基于扩散的先验或合成数据来对静态 3D 集合进行动画处理，从而绕过这些硬件限制rely on massive, synchronized multi-camera rigs. While they capture occlusion-free objects with high-quality dynamics, these systems are prohibitively expensive, strictly confined to controlled studio environments, and fundamentally unscalable for open-world data collection. On the other hand, recent generative approaches attempt to bypass these hardware constraints by leveraging diffusion-based priors or synthetic data to either animating static 3D collections[objaverse, objaversexl, hy3dbench]朝向 4D 设置towards 4D settings[chen2026motion, mou2025dimo]或从单目视频输入重建空间框架or to reconstruct the spatial frame from monocular video inputs[4d-lrm, l4gm, gvfdiffusion, stag4d, fb4d]。然而，当前的生成模型主要关注孤立的、风格化的资产，例如游戏或卡通人物。当面对现实世界中复杂多样的对象交互时，它们会遭受严重的域差距，导致生成质量不稳定，表现为难以置信的物理变形、浮动交互和明显的时间抖动。. However, current generative models primarily focus on isolated, stylized assets, such as gaming or cartoon characters. When confronted with the complex and diverse object interactions present in the real world, they suffer from severe domain gaps that lead to unstable generation quality, manifests as implausible physical-deformations, floating interactions, and noticeable temporal jittering.

为了打破多视图捕获的不可扩展的成本和生成模型的不可靠的质量之间的僵局，我们提出To break the deadlock between the unscalable cost of multi-view capture and the unreliable quality of generative models, we proposeHAT-4D, 低成本,, a low-cost,人在环（HITL）human-in-the-loop (HITL)用于单眼 4D 对象交互生成的代理框架。给定野外单目视频，HAT-4D 首先利用视觉语言模型 (VLM) 代理将视觉序列组织成结构化的agentic framework for monocular 4D object interaction generation. Given an in-the-wild monocular video, HAT-4D first leverages Vision-Language Model (VLM) agents to organize the visual sequence into a structured交互知识图（IKG）Interaction Knowledge Graph (IKG)。作为我们框架的核心因果引擎，IKG 有效地编码长期物理变化以及驱动它们的底层交互线索。在 IKG 的指导下，HAT-4D 协调了一套专门的代理：它耦合. Serving as the core causality engine of our framework, the IKG efficiently encodes long-term physical changes and the underlying interaction cues that drive them. Guided by IKG, HAT-4D orchestrates a suite of specialized agents: it couples3D 对象生成和组合技能3D object generation and composition skills恢复交互实体的精确几何形状和空间对齐，并随后应用to recover the precise geometry and spatial alignment of interacting entities, and subsequently applies4D传播技巧4D propagation skills重建它们不断发展的动态。为了明确解决单目视频固有的严重深度和遮挡模糊性，我们通过新颖的 HITL 协作方案将高级人类知识集成到生成循环中，使用户能够主动指导和完善 3D 生成、空间合成和动态 4D 传播过程。to reconstruct their evolving dynamics. To explicitly resolve the severe depth and occlusion ambiguities inherent to monocular video, we integrate high-level human knowledge into the generation loop via a novel HITL collaborative scheme, empowering users to actively guide and refine the 3D generation, spatial composition, and dynamic 4D propagation processes.

利用 HAT-4D 作为高度可扩展的数据引擎，我们构建Leveraging HAT-4D as a highly scalable data engine, we constructMVOIK-4D（多视图对象交互4D知识）MVOIK-4D (Multi-View Object Interaction 4D Knowledge)该基准包含 112 个不同交互场景中的 77 项任务，以及一种新颖的多维评估协议，旨在严格评估物理合理性和交互稳定性，涉及变形真实性、交互一致性、时间平滑性、交叉视图和长期记忆保存。大量实验验证，HAT-4D 在复杂多对象交互建模方面始终优于现有的单目 4D 基线，通过提供高保真、可扩展的物理先验，为下游的 Embodied AI 研究铺平了道路。benchmark encompassing 77 tasks across 112 distinct interaction scenarios, alongside a novel multi-dimensional evaluation protocol designed to rigorously assess physical plausibility and interaction stability involving deformation realism, interaction consistency, temporal smoothness, cross-view and long-term memory preservation. Extensive experiments validate that HAT-4D consistently outperforms existing monocular 4D baselines in modeling complex multi-object interactions, paving the way for downstream Embodied AI research by supplying high-fidelity, scalable physical priors.

总之，我们的主要贡献是： (1) 我们建议In summary, our main contributions are: (1) We proposeHAT-4D，一种创新的人机循环多智能体系统，旨在直接从单目视频重建物理上合理且时间连贯的 4D 多对象交互。 (2)我们介绍, an innovative human-in-the-loop multi-agent system designed to reconstruct physically plausible and temporally coherent 4D multi-object interactions directly from monocular videos. (2) We introduce交互知识图（IKG）Interaction Knowledge Graph (IKG)作为我们框架的核心因果引擎。通过显式编码长期物理变化，IKG 指导我们专门的 3D 生成和 4D 传播代理解决严重的深度模糊和相互遮挡问题。 (3) 我们建立as the core causality engine of our framework. By explicitly encoding long-term physical changes, the IKG guides our specialized 3D generation and 4D propagation agents to resolve severe depth ambiguities and mutual occlusions. (3) We establishMVOIK-4D，一个涵盖广泛交互场景的综合基准，加上新颖的多维评估协议来评估物理合理性和时间一致性。, a comprehensive benchmark encompassing a wide range of interaction scenarios, coupled with a novel multi-dimensional evaluation protocol to assess physical plausibility and temporal consistency.

2 相关工作Related Work

2.1 对象交互知识理解Object Interaction Knowledge Understanding

早期关于对象交互理解的研究主要集中在 图像级推理，例如对象关系检测Early studies on object interaction understanding mainly focus on image-level reasoning, such as object relation detection[krishna2016visualgenomeconnectinglanguage, li2022sgtrendtoendscenegraph, liu2025interacted]和对象可供性检测。and object affordance detection.[do2018affordancenetendtoenddeeplearning, chen2023affordancegroundingdemonstrationvideo]随着视觉语言模型（VLM）的发展， 最近的作品将这个方向扩展到长视频， 通过时间推理实现更丰富的交互理解With the development of vision-language models (VLMs), Recent works extend this direction to long videos, enabling richer interaction understanding through temporal reasoning[cheng2024videollama2advancingspatialtemporal, wang2024internvideo2scalingfoundationmodels].

随着3D重建的进展With the progress of 3D reconstruction[liu2023zero1to3zeroshotimage3d, hong2024lrmlargereconstructionmodel, wang2025vggtvisualgeometrygrounded]以及动态场景建模and dynamic scene modeling[wu20244dgaussiansplattingrealtime, zhang2025efficientlyreconstructingdynamicscenes]，4D领域的对象交互理解开始引起关注。 在 4D 设置中，交互涉及复杂的时空动力学 超越静态语义关系。 然而，收集大规模的现实世界 4D 交互数据是很困难的。 因此，现有数据集仍然很大程度上局限于合成环境。, object interaction understanding in the 4D domain has begun to attract attention. In 4D settings, interactions involve complex spatio-temporal dynamics beyond static semantic relationships. However, collecting large-scale real-world 4D interaction data is difficult. As a result, existing datasets are still largely limited to synthetic environments.

在这项工作中，我们通过代理驱动框架研究现实世界 4D 对象交互的理解。 我们构建了一个多视图对象交互数据集，具有涵盖不同交互场景的丰富注释。 为了明确表示动态场景中的复杂交互， 我们介绍一个In this work, we study real-world 4D object interaction understanding with an agent-driven framework. We construct a multi-view object interaction dataset with rich annotations covering diverse interaction scenarios. To explicitly represent complex interactions in dynamic scenes, we introduce an交互知识图谱interaction knowledge graph模拟对象关系， 相互作用类别和随时间变化的变形状态。 这种结构化表示捕获了潜在的时空交互动态 并提供从单目视频重建 4D 对象交互的指导。that models object relationships, interaction categories, and deformation states over time. This structured representation captures the underlying spatio-temporal interaction dynamics and provides guidance for reconstructing 4D object interactions from monocular videos.

2.2 基于单目视频的 4D 生成Monocular Video-based 4D Generation

随着视频扩散模型的发展With the development of the video diffusion model[stablediffusion, svd, sv3d]以及大规模动态 3D 对象数据集and a large-scale dynamic 3D object dataset[objaverse, objaversexl, vividzoo, texverse]，4D内容生成越来越受到关注。 4D 生成的最新研究大致可分为两个范式。 第一个范例是基于优化的，通过分数蒸馏采样 (SDS) 利用预训练的图像或视频扩散模型来提取 4D 特征, 4D content generation attracts more and more attention. Recent research in 4D generation can be broadly divided into two paradigms. The first paradigm is optimization-based, leveraging pretrained image or video diffusion models through Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) to extract 4D features[consistent4d, stag4d, birth, fb4d]。 然而，分数蒸馏采样（SDS）在生成复杂对象时经常遇到 Janus 问题。 第二种范式遵循数据集驱动的端到端方法，依赖于大规模 3D 或 4D 数据集. However, Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) often suffers from the Janus problem when generating the complex object. The second paradigm follows a dataset-driven, end-to-end approach that relies on large-scale 3D or 4D datasets[sv4d, l4gm, gvfdiffusion, v2m4]。 SV4D等型号. Models such as SV4D[sv4d],L4GM, L4GM[l4gm]和 GVF 扩散, and GVF-Diffusion[gvfdiffusion]通过引入时空交叉注意力层来扩展高保真 3D 生成架构，从而实现端到端动态场景生成。 然而，这些模型通常是在大规模合成数据集上进行训练的。 当应用于现实场景时，它们的性能通常会由于显着的域间隙而降低。extend high-fidelity 3D generation architectures by introducing spatio-temporal cross-attention layers, enabling end-to-end dynamic scene generation. However, these models are typically trained on large-scale synthetic datasets. When applied to real-world scenes, their performance often degrades due to the significant domain gap.

为了应对这些挑战，我们建议To address these challenges, we proposeHAT-4D，一个代理驱动的框架，将多层次的人机交互反馈集成到 4D 生成过程中。 通过在生成过程中引入人工修正，该框架有效地减少了错误累积并提高了生成交互的物理合理性。 当物体经历严重遮挡或长时间间隔后重新出现时，它还可以减轻记忆退化。 此外，HAT-4D 作为高效的 4D 数据引擎来构建, an agent-driven framework that integrates multi-level human-in-the-loop feedback into the 4D generation process. By introducing human corrections during generation, the framework effectively reduces error accumulation and improves the physical plausibility of generated interactions. It also mitigates memory degradation when objects undergo heavy occlusions or reappear after long temporal gaps. Furthermore, HAT-4D serves as an efficient 4D data engine to construct theMVOIK-4D基准，缓解现实世界 4D 对象交互数据的缺乏。benchmark, alleviating the lack of real-world 4D object interaction data.

2.3 视觉任务中的人机交互工具Human-in-the-loop Tool in Visual Tasks

人机交互（HITL）方法长期以来与数据构建和注释数据的稀缺性密切相关。早期研究主要通过主动学习来探索HITLHuman-in-the-loop (HITL) methods have long been closely related to data construction and the scarcity of annotated data. Early studies mainly explored HITL through active learning[settles2009active]，其中模型识别不确定样本并请求人工注释，此类策略已广泛应用于对象检测, where models identify uncertain samples and request human annotations, and such strategies have been widely applied in object detection[yu2022consistencybasedactivelearningobject]和医学成像任务and medical imaging tasks[Wang_2019, Budd_2021].

随着深度学习的发展，HITL已经演变成一种数据引擎范式。例如，分割任何内容With the development of deep learning, HITL has evolved into a data engine paradigm. For example, Segment Anything[kirillov2023segment]引入了人类模型数据引擎，通过模型预测和人类校正迭代扩展大规模分割数据集，从而在开放世界场景中实现强大的分割性能。 最近的作品将这个想法扩展到 3D 领域introduces a human–model data engine that iteratively expands large-scale segmentation datasets through model prediction and human correction, enabling strong segmentation performance in open-world scenarios. Recent works extend this idea to the 3D domain[cen2024segment3dradiancefields, wang2019latteacceleratinglidarpoint]，其中通过人工评估或专家校正来完善模型预测，以构建大规模 3D 训练数据并缓解现实世界 3D 数据集的稀缺性。, where model predictions are refined through human evaluation or expert correction to construct large-scale 3D training data and alleviate the scarcity of real-world 3D datasets.

在这项工作中，我们进一步将此范例扩展到动态 4D 重建。利用视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的小样本功能，我们提出了 HAT-4D，这是一种人类代理协作框架，可解决现实世界 4D 交互数据的稀缺问题。我们的代理在生成过程中执行自动修复，同时在稀疏关键帧处引入人工反馈以纠正累积的错误，从而实现复杂对象交互的可靠重建。In this work, we further extend this paradigm to dynamic 4D reconstruction. Leveraging the few-shot capabilities of vision–language models (VLMs), we propose HAT-4D, a human–agent collaborative framework that addresses the scarcity of real-world 4D interaction data. Our agent performs automatic repair during generation, while human feedback is introduced at sparse keyframes to correct accumulated errors, enabling reliable reconstruction of complex object interactions.

3 方法Method

我们的目标是从单目视频重建 4D 多对象交互，这项任务因严重的深度模糊、严重遮挡和不断变化的拓扑状态而受到阻碍。 为了克服这些挑战并减少错误积累，我们建议Our objective is to reconstruct 4D multi-object interactions from monocular videos, a task hindered by severe depth ambiguities, heavy occlusions, and evolving topological states. To overcome these challenges and mitigate error accumulation, we proposeHAT-4D，一个代理框架（图，, an agentic framework (Fig,2）由显式驱动) driven by an explicit交互知识图（IKG）Interaction Knowledge Graph (IKG)。在此框架内，相互作用的实体及其物理变形被重建为 4D 高斯图. Within this framework, interacting entities and their physical deformations are reconstructed as 4D Gaussian Splats[wu20244dgaussiansplattingrealtime]并组织成关键的互动事件片段。 在 IKG 的指导下，我们的专业代理确保物理上合理的 3D 生成和时间上一致的 4D 传播，同时多层次and organized into critical interaction event segments. Guided by the IKG, our specialized agents ensure physically plausible 3D generation and temporally consistent 4D propagation, while multi-level人在环（HITL）human-in-the-loop (HITL)协作可以实现精确的几何细化和语义编辑。本节的其余部分组织如下：collaboration enables precise geometric refinement and semantic editing. The remainder of this section is organized as follows: Sec.3.1详细阐述了details the formulation of theIKG;秒。; Sec.3.2描述了describes theHAT-4D代理系统，包括 3D 生成、空间构成和记忆增强 4D 传播技能；和秒。agentic system, encompassing 3D generation, spatial composition, and memory-augmented 4D propagation skills; and Sec.3.3介绍我们的多层次introduces our multi-levelHITL协作机制。collaborative mechanisms.

3.2 使用 HAT-4D 进行 4D 生成和传播4D Generation and Propagation with HAT-4D

将 IKG 建立为形式约束引擎后，HAT-4D 协调多智能体系统来执行重建。该系统通过调用 3D 生成、合成和 4D 传播技能，从静态 3D 提升过渡到动态 4D 传播，并通过自动评估和回滚来减少错误累积。With the IKG established as a formal constraint engine, HAT-4D orchestrates a multi-agent system to execute the reconstruction. The system transitions from static 3D lifting to dynamic 4D propagation by invoking 3D generation, composition, and 4D propagation skills, with automatic evaluation and rollback to mitigate error accumulation.

3D 对象生成和组合。3D Object Generation and Composition.生成过程开始于The generation process begins with the3D物体生成技能3D Object Generation Skill，它在第一帧和关键帧处初始化场景, which initializes the scene at both the first frame and at keyframesT¨\ddot{T}由 IKG 标记。 对于每个帧，代理首先为 IKG 标识的每个实体生成一组虚拟锚点，然后调用 SAM3Dflagged by IKG. For each frame, the agent first produces a set of virtual anchors for each entity identified by the IKG and then invokes SAM3D[sam3d]将这些单独的实体定位并重建为 3D 高斯图。 由于严重遮挡可能会导致多个锚点被分配给单个物理实体，因此代理利用对象检测来识别和合并此类实例。对于从属于同一物理实体的多个锚点重建的 3D 对象，代理有选择地保留与 IKG 中指定的对象语义最接近的候选对象，并表现出最高的重建质量。to localize and reconstruct these individual entities as 3D Gaussian Splats. Since heavy occlusions may cause multiple anchors to be assigned to a single physical entity, the agent leverages object detection to identify and consolidate such instances. For 3D objects reconstructed from multiple anchors belonging to the same physical entity, the agent selectively retains the candidate that most closely aligns with the object semantics specified in the IKG and exhibits the highest reconstruction quality.

重建后，Following reconstruction, the3D 物体组合技巧3D Object Composition Skill将独立资产集成到连贯的 3D 场景中。在 IKG 中定义的相对空间时间线的指导下，代理利用轻量级姿态优化算子来细化每个实体的 6DoF 位置和方向。此外，如果适用，代理会计算实体之间的精确接触点，以确保生成的组合在物理上合理且交互一致。最后，这些来自第一帧和选定关键帧的合成 3D 结果被缓存在integrates the independent assets into a coherent 3D scene. Guided by the relative spatial timelines defined in the IKG, the agent leverages a lightweight pose optimization operator to refine the 6DoF positions and orientations of each entity. Furthermore, the agent computes exact contact points between entities, if applicable, to ensure the resulting composition is physically plausible and interaction-consistent. Finally, these composed 3D results from the first frame and selected keyframes are cached in a记忆库memory bank，作为后续 4D 传播的鲁棒空间锚点。, serving as robust spatial anchors for subsequent 4D propagation.

内存增强 4D 传播。Memory-Augmented 4D Propagation.为了跨时间扩展合成的 3D 场景，HAT-4D 采用分段方式To extend the composed 3D scene across time, HAT-4D employs a segment-wise4D 传播算子4D Propagation Operator (L4GM [l4gm]），我们渲染的地方), where we render443D 合成的正交平面作为空间初始化。 4D 传播算子以第一帧之前的精炼帧和内存库中的关键帧为条件，确保长期时间稳定性并在整个高度动态交互阶段保持严格的对象身份一致性。orthogonal planes from the 3D composition result as spatial initialization. The 4D propagation operator is conditioned on both immediately preceding refined frames from the first frame and keyframes in the memory bank, ensuring long-term temporal stability and maintaining strict object identity consistency throughout highly dynamic interaction phases.

多维度评估和回滚。Multi-Dimensional Evaluation and Rollback.为了系统地防止错误累积，专用的 4D 生成评估技能充当系统的批评者。对于每个传播的 4D 片段，代理将最近的帧渲染为多视图视频，并执行由跨两个维度的 IKG 约束驱动的全面评估：To systematically prevent error accumulation, a dedicated 4D Generation Evaluation Skill serves as the system’s critic. For each propagated 4D segment, the agent renders recent frames into multi-view videos and performs a comprehensive assessment driven by the IKG constraints across two dimensions:

  • •

    动态评估Dynamic Assessment评估时间序列上的物理合理性（例如，互穿违规）和长期记忆稳定性；evaluates physical plausibility (e.g., interpenetration violations) and long-term memory stability over the temporal sequence;

  • •

    静态评估Static Assessment检查各个资产的视觉保真度、纹理质量和跨视图一致性。examines visual fidelity, texture quality, and cross-view consistency of the individual assets.

当代理发现错误时，它会向相应的生成代理提供详细的诊断描述并触发选择性回滚。与动态物理相关的错误会在 4D 传播阶段触发局部重新生成，而与静态视觉质量相关的伪影会导致完全回滚到 3D 对象生成阶段以进行几何细化。When the agent identifies an error, it provides detailed diagnostic descriptions to the corresponding generative agents and triggers a selective rollback. Errors related to dynamic physics trigger a localized re-generation at the 4D propagation stage, whereas artifacts related to static visual quality lead to a complete rollback to the 3D object generation stage for geometric refinement.

3.3 多层次的人在环协作Multi-Level Human-in-the-Loop Collaboration

尽管视觉语言模型 (VLM) 在理解开放世界环境下的物理知识方面表现出强大的泛化能力，但基于单目视频的 4D 生成仍然是一个高度不适定的问题。在存在多种合理解释的模糊场景中，人类知识仍然至关重要。在本小节中，我们将描述如何通过多级细化算子将人类知识融入到生成管道的不同阶段，从而指导 VLM 实现更可靠的动态 3D 生成。Although vision–language models (VLMs) exhibit strong generalization capabilities in understanding physical knowledge under open-world settings, monocular video-based 4D generation remains a highly ill-posed problem. In ambiguous scenarios where multiple plausible interpretations exist, human knowledge is still essential. In this subsection, we describe how human knowledge is incorporated at different stages of the generation pipeline through multi-level refinement operators, guiding VLMs toward more reliable dynamic 3D generation.

通过人工反馈进行在线微调。Online Fine-tuning with Human Feedback.在生成特定视频片段的过程中，当VLM驱动代理产生的输出不令人满意时，人类用户可以直接纠正生成的结果。然后将这些更正制定为系统提示，并在后续调用中提供给相应的代理。通过这种方式，人类知识被注入在线微调代理中，使系统能够以最小的额外成本调整其行为。不同代理使用的具体提示格式详见附录。During the generation of specific video segments, when the output produced by VLM-driven agents is unsatisfactory, human users can directly correct the generated results. These corrections are then formulated as system prompts and provided to the corresponding agents in subsequent invocations. In this way, human knowledge is injected into an online fine-tuning agent, enabling the system to adapt its behavior with minimal additional cost. The specific prompt formats used by different agents are detailed in the appendix.

多层次的人炼干员。Multi-level Human Refinement Operators.为了支持高效的人工引导细化 3D 生成结果，HAT-4D 提供了一组多级细化运算符。To support efficient human-guided refinement of 3D generation results, HAT-4D provides a set of multi-level refinement operators.

  • •

    高斯级细化：Gaussian-level Refinement:用户可以直接修改所选高斯图的属性，包括位置、方向、颜色和不透明度。Users can directly modify attributes of selected Gaussian Splats, including position, orientation, color, and opacity.

  • •

    区域级细化：Region-level Refinement:用户可以选择生成质量较差的区域，使用多视图视频生成模型通过局部潜在去噪来执行局部重新生成和优化。Users can select regions with poor generation quality, where local re-generation and optimization are performed using multi-view video generation models via local latent denoising.

  • •

    对象级细化：Object-level Refinement:可以使用 SAM3D 重新生成特定对象，然后进行姿势调整以更好地与交互环境保持一致。Specific objects can be re-generated using SAM3D, followed by pose adjustment to better align with the interaction context.

除了交互式编辑之外，HAT-4D还利用这些人工改进的输出来建立一个持续自我改进的数据引擎。通过协作过程生成的 4D 资产可作为高保真伪地面实况，用于对底层可学习 4D 生成算子进行离线微调，为在现实世界的 Embodied AI 应用程序中生成强大的物理先验建立可扩展的桥梁。Beyond interactive editing, HAT-4D leverages these human-refined outputs to establish a continuous self-improving data engine. The generated 4D assets through the collaboration process serve as high-fidelity pseudo ground-truth for the offline fine-tuning of the underlying learnable 4D generation operators, establishing a scalable bridge for producing robust physical priors in real-world Embodied AI applications.

4 基准和指标Benchmark and Metrics

为了系统地评估我们提出的 HAT-4D 框架在重建复杂的动态对象交互方面的性能，我们引入了一个新颖的基准数据集To systematically evaluate the performance of our proposed HAT-4D framework in reconstructing complex, dynamic object interactions, we introduce a novel benchmark datasetMVOIK-4D，以及量身定制的多维评估协议，涉及整体视觉保真度、时空记忆保留以及重建交互的物理合理性。, alongside a tailored multi-dimensional evaluation protocol involving overall visual fidelity, spatio-temporal memory retention, and the physical plausibility of the reconstructed interactions.

4.1 MVOIK-4D：多视图对象交互知识数据集MVOIK-4D: Multi-View Object Interaction Knowledge Dataset

多视图对象交互知识数据集 (MVOIK-4D) 使用动画 3D 资源和自定义多摄像头捕捉系统构建，具有以下两个互补子集：The Multi-View Object Interaction Knowledge dataset (MVOIK-4D) is constructed using animated 3D assets and a custom multi-camera capture system, with the following two complementary subsets:

  • •

    工具OIK-4DToolOIK-4D专注于涉及复杂变形的基于工具的交互。它涵盖了不同的工具（例如刀、钳子、打火机）和目标（刚性固体、可变形固体、液体），具有液体飞溅、水果切片和剥皮等 6 个高度动态的交互类别。focuses on tool-based interactions involving complex deformations. It covers diverse tools (e.g., knife, tongs, lighter) and targets (rigid solids, deformable solids, liquids), featuring 6 highly dynamic interaction categories like liquid splashing, fruit slicing, and peeling.

  • •

    记忆OIK-4DMemoryOIK-4D针对动态相互遮挡场景中的时空推理。它包括targets spatio-temporal reasoning in scenarios with dynamic mutual occlusions. It includes骗局游戏shell games, 观点变化下的内容揭示交互content-revealing interactions under viewpoint changes, 和, and遮挡下基于工具的交互tool-based interactions under occlusions，具有来自特定输入视点的少量注释，以及对依赖于记忆的重建至关重要的感兴趣区域。, with few-shot annotations from specific input viewpoints, along with regions of interest that are critical to memory-dependent reconstruction.

如图所示。As in Fig.4，我们构建了一个多摄像头捕捉系统，通过校准的多视图观察来获取真实世界的物体交互数据（详细信息请参阅附录）。 对于, we built a multi-camera capture system to acquire real-world object interaction data with calibrated multi-view observations (see Appendix for details). For the记忆OIK-4DMemoryOIK-4D具体来说，我们识别输入视点，其中对象可见性在不同视图之间发生有意的变化，并利用视频分割注释工具来标记与依赖于记忆的推理密切相关的重建区域。subset specifically, we identify input viewpoints where object visibility undergoes deliberate changes across views, and leverage video segmentation annotation tools to label reconstruction regions that are closely related to memory-dependent reasoning.

4.2 多维度评估Multi-Dimensional Evaluation

标准 3D/4D 生成指标不足以捕获交互实体的物理细微差别。因此，我们提出了一种针对动态多对象场景的多维评估协议。Standard 3D/4D generation metrics are insufficient for capturing the physical nuances of interacting entities. Therefore, we propose a multi-dimensional evaluation protocol tailored for dynamic multi-object scenarios.

总体生成质量。Overall Generation Quality.遵循Constant4DFollowing Consistent4D[consistent4d]，我们通过计算多摄像机捕获的真实多视图视频与模型生成的相应渲染输出之间的 CLIP、LPIPS 和 FVD 分数来评估基线生成质量和时间一致性。, we evaluate the baseline generation quality and temporal consistency by computing CLIP, LPIPS, and FVD scores between the ground-truth multi-view videos captured by multi cameras and the corresponding rendered outputs generated by the models.

时间记忆质量。Temporal Memory Quality.我们从三个不同的层面评估模型的时间记忆能力：We evaluate the model’s temporal memory capability across three distinct levels:

  • •

    帧到帧连续性：Frame-to-Frame Continuity:我们采用 VBench 中的光流对齐残差度量We adopt the optical-flow-aligned residual metric from VBench[huang2023vbenchcomprehensivebenchmarksuite]测量连续帧之间的高频时间抖动。我们计算真实帧之间的梯度差to measure high-frequency temporal jitter between consecutive frames. We calculate the gradient difference between the ground-truth frameItI_{t}和扭曲的前一帧and the warped previous frameIt^\hat{I_{t}}，称之为内部质量。与平均像素强度的 MSE 不同，该指标对纹理闪烁和细粒度伪像敏感，这些伪像通常在感知上令人不安，但在标准指标中数值很小。, call it intra-quality. Unlike MSE, which averages out pixel intensities, this metric is sensitive to texture flickering and fine-grained artifacts that are often perceptually disturbing but numerically small in standard metrics.

  • •

    长期记忆稳定性：Long-Term Memory Stability:为了评估长期对象持久性，我们利用 DINOv3To evaluate the long-term object permanence, we utilize DINOv3[simeoni2025dinov3]将一张图片分割成方形“块”并提取每个块的特征。然后我们通过余弦相似度评估两个不同补丁的相似度。我们将内存补丁定义为“与过去输入中出现的某些补丁相似的补丁，但目前不可见”。最终分数可以计算为预测图片与gt图片之间的记忆块数量的比率。 附录中提供了该指标的详细分析。to split one picture into square "patches" and extract the features of every patch. Then we evaluate the similarity of two different patches by cosine-similarity. We define memory patches as "those patches similar to some patch appearing in the past of input, but not visible at present". The final score can be calculated as the ratio of the number of memory patches between the predicted picture and the gt picture. The detailed analysis of this metric is provided in the appendix.

交互重建质量。Interaction Reconstruction Quality.我们利用Qwen3-VLWe utilize Qwen3-VL[bai2025qwen3vltechnicalreport]根据交互过程中对象变形的真实性和空间边界的准确性（例如，是否发生相互渗透）对物理合理性进行定性排名。 为了进一步验证 Qwen3-VL 评估的可靠性，我们进行了一项用户研究，将人类的判断与模型的排名进行比较，证明它们之间具有很强的一致性。 附录中提供了Qwen3-VL的详细提示设计以及与人类评估的相关性分析。to qualitatively rank physical plausibility based on the realism of object deformations and the accuracy of spatial bounds during interaction (e.g., if interpenetration occurred or not). To further validate the reliability of the Qwen3-VL evaluation, we conduct a user study comparing human judgments with the model’s rankings, demonstrating strong consistency between them. The detailed prompt design for Qwen3-VL and the correlation analysis with human evaluations are provided in the appendix.

5 实验Experiment

5.1 设置Setting

基线。Baselines.

为了分析现有 4D 生成模型处理动态对象交互的能力，我们选择了几种有代表性的端到端 4D 生成方法作为基线。这些型号包括L4GMTo analyze the capability of existing 4D generation models in handling dynamic object interactions, we select several representative end-to-end 4D generation methods as baselines. These models include L4GM[l4gm], GVFD 扩散, GVFDiffusion[gvfdiffusion],SV4D, SV4D[sv4d]，以及基于 SDS 的方法，例如 STAG4D, as well as SDS-based approaches such as STAG4D[stag4d]和FB4Dand FB4D[fb4d]。 我们采用开源Qwen-VL 235B-A22B-Instruct模型作为视觉语言模型（VLM）、SAM3D和L4GM. We adopt the open-source Qwen-VL 235B-A22B-Instruct model as the vision–language model (VLM), SAM3D and L4GM[l4gm]分别作为 3D/4D 生成算子。我们使用as 3D/4D generation operators respectively. We usel​r=1×10−5lr=1\times 10^{-5}对于姿势优化器，并将内存库大小设置为 8，其中模型为以当前帧为条件的后续 7 帧生成 3D 高斯。 作为消融，HAT-4D（w.o. IKG）仅生成交互场景的简单描述，而不是高度结构化且信息丰富的 IKG。 HAT-4D（无存储器）限制存储器组的大小为零。for the pose optimizer, and set the memory bank size to 8, where the model generates 3D Gaussians for the subsequent 7 frames conditioned on the current frame. As ablation, HAT-4D (w.o. IKG) generates only a simple description of the interaction scene instead of a highly structured and informative IKG. HAT-4D (w.o. memory) limit the size of memory bank is zero.

5.2 对比实验Comparative Experiment

标签。Tab.1报告了 HAT-4D、其消融变体和其他单目视频到 4D 基准在 MVOIK-4D 基准上跨多个评估维度的性能。reports the performance of HAT-4D, its ablated variants and other monocular video-to-4D baselines on the MVOIK-4D benchmark across multiple evaluation dimensions.

整体品质。Overall quality.HAT-4D 在 LPIPS 和 FVD 上均实现了最佳性能，表明生成的 4D 序列的感知质量和时间真实性显着提高。这一改进证明了代理驱动的细化管道的有效性。它通过迭代交互感知优化逐步提高生成质量。HAT-4D achieves the best performance on both LPIPS and FVD, indicating significantly improved perceptual quality and temporal realism of the generated 4D sequences. This improvement demonstrates the effectiveness of the agent-driven refinement pipeline. It progressively enhances generation quality through iterative interaction-aware optimization.

交互质量。Interaction quality.在特定于交互的指标上，HAT-4D 在变形精度和关系一致性方面都显示出显着的改进。这表明我们的方法可以更好地捕获物理上合理的对象变形，同时在整个动态过程中保持交互对象之间的正确空间关系。On the interaction-specific metrics, HAT-4D shows substantial improvements in both deformation accuracy and relational consistency. This suggests that our approach better captures physically plausible object deformations while maintaining correct spatial relationships between interacting objects throughout the dynamic process.

内存一致性。Memory consistency.HAT-4D 在所有临时内存指标上均实现了最先进的性能。特别是，我们的方法显着提高了短期时间平滑性和长期一致性。这一结果证明了在扩展时间序列和多个视点上保持相干对象状态的强大能力。HAT-4D achieves state-of-the-art performance across all temporal memory metrics. In particular, our method significantly improves both short-term temporal smoothness and long-horizon consistency. This result demonstrates strong capability in preserving coherent object states across extended temporal sequences and multiple viewpoints.

关键模块消融。Key Module Ablation.添加 IKG 可以改善交互重建和记忆一致性。它增加了变形、关系、内部和长分数。然而，结构化 IKG 中的较长上下文会略微降低 CLIP 和 FVD 性能，可能是因为它削弱了基于 VLM 的区分。内存模块主要提高长期一致性。它保留了对象状态并在长序列上保持时间稳定性。Adding IKG improves interaction reconstruction and memory consistency. It increases the Deform, Relation, Intra, and Long scores. However, the longer context from the structured IKG slightly reduces CLIP and FVD performance, likely because it weakens VLM-based discrimination. The memory module mainly improves long-term consistency. It preserves object states and maintains temporal stability over long sequences.

定性分析Qualitative Analysis。 如图所示。. As shown in Fig.5，我们对 HAT-4D 和几种用于单目重建对象交互的基线方法进行了定性比较。 结果表明，HAT-4D 中的渐进式评估和生成策略在生成过程中产生更稳定的动态重建。, we present qualitative comparisons between HAT-4D and several baseline methods for monocular reconstruction of object interactions. The results demonstrate that the progressive evaluation and generation strategy in HAT-4D produces more stable dynamic reconstructions during the generation process.

例如，在剪辑-卡片交互中，剪辑的形状在帧之间保持清晰和一致，而其他方法则存在结构不稳定的问题。 此外，HAT-4D 可以更准确地重建交互区域。在具有挑战性的情况下，例如刀切香蕉和打火机点火，我们的方法保留了更清晰的几何形状和更清晰的交互边界。For example, in the clip–card interaction, the shape of the clip remains clear and consistent across frames, while other methods suffer from structural instability. Moreover, HAT-4D reconstructs interaction regions more accurately. In challenging cases, such as knife cutting a banana and lighter ignition, our method preserves sharper geometry and clearer interaction boundaries.

此外，HAT-4D 可以更好地捕捉被操纵对象的变化。例如，与基线方法相比，重建的火焰表现出更清晰的结构和更稳定的时间动态。In addition, HAT-4D better captures changes in the manipulated objects. For instance, the reconstructed flame exhibits clearer structure and more stable temporal dynamics compared with baseline methods.

5.3 关于人类干预的消融Ablations about Human Intervention

5.3.1 不同的人为干预。Different Human Intervention.

我们研究不同程度的人为干预如何影响 HAT-4D 的性能。 该实验在 MVOIK-4D 数据集中的 39 个序列上进行，其中 17 个序列包含具有挑战性的记忆密集型交互。 在生成过程中，我们限制人工注释的最大数量，并评估不同人工干预频率下的性能。We study how different levels of human intervention influence the performance of HAT-4D. The experiment is conducted on 39 sequences from the MVOIK-4D dataset, among which 17 sequences contain challenging memory-intensive interactions. During generation, we limit the maximum number of human annotations and evaluate the performance under different human intervention frequencies.

如表所示。As shown in Tab.2和图。and Fig.6(a)，即使是有限的人为干预也能在完全代理驱动的环境中持续提高重建质量、交互准确性和时间一致性。, even limited human intervention consistently improves reconstruction quality, interaction accuracy, and temporal consistency over the fully agent-driven setting.

当只允许进行少量干预时，这种改善尤其显着。 纠正几个关键帧足以修复生成的动力学和交互状态中的主要错误。 随着干预次数的进一步增加，性能增益逐渐饱和。 这一观察结果表明，稀疏的人类知识可以有效指导生成过程，并大幅提高动态 4D 重建的可靠性。The improvement is particularly significant when only a few interventions are allowed. Correcting several critical frames is sufficient to fix major errors in the generated dynamics and interaction states. As the number of interventions increases further, the performance gain gradually saturates. This observation indicates that sparse human knowledge can effectively guide the generation process and substantially improve the reliability of dynamic 4D reconstruction.

5.3.2 不同的细化运算符。Different Refinement Operators.

我们在 10 个随机抽样案例上评估不同的细化算子。 对于每个设置，志愿者只能使用指定的细化工具。 完全由代理驱动的管道作为基线。We evaluate different refinement operators on 10 randomly sampled cases. For each setting, volunteers can only use the specified refinement tools. The fully agent-driven pipeline serves as the baseline.

如表所示。As shown in Tab.2，对象级细化通过纠正几何、姿势、遮挡和交互错误产生最大增益。区域级和高斯级细化提供了互补的改进：前者实现了最佳的 FVD 和长分数，而后者通过减少局部伪影和外观不一致，在 CLIP、LPIPS 和 Relation 上表现最佳。, object-level refinement yields the largest gain by correcting geometry, pose, occlusion, and interaction errors. Region-level and Gaussian-level refinements provide complementary improvements: the former achieves the best FVD and Long scores, while the latter performs best on CLIP, LPIPS, and Relation by reducing local artifacts and appearance inconsistencies.

总体而言，对象级细化是主要的校正工具。 区域级和高斯级算子用于细粒度的局部调整。 这与我们实际的注释工作流程是一致的。Overall, object-level refinement is the primary correction tool. Region-level and Gaussian-level operators are used for fine-grained local adjustments. This is consistent with our practical annotation workflow.

5.3.3 在不同视图中微调基线Baseline Finetuned in Different Views

我们从 MVOIK-4D 中选择了 63 个高质量带注释的场景，并将它们以 9:1 的比例分成训练集和测试集。 为了遵循L4GM的训练协议，每个场景被分为8帧的剪辑。 这会产生 1,275 个训练剪辑和 97 个测试剪辑。对于每个场景，我们选择一个真实捕获的视点作为参考视图。 四个正交视图在其周围渲染并用作输入视图。 另外四个捕获的视点被保留作为评估的验证视图。We select 63 high-quality annotated scenes from MVOIK-4D and split them into training and test sets with a ratio of 9:1. To follow the training protocol of L4GM, each scene is divided into clips with 8 frames. This produces 1,275 training clips and 97 test clips. For each scene, we choose one real captured viewpoint as the reference view. Four orthogonal views are rendered around it and used as input views. Another four captured viewpoints are reserved as validation views for evaluation.

为了研究视图监督的效果，我们渲染了 24 个来自小角度和径向扰动的抖动视图和 16 个均匀采样的随机视图。 图。To study the effect of view supervision, we render 24 jittered views from small angular and radial perturbations and 16 uniformly sampled random views. Fig.6显示了 MVOIK-4D 上 L4GM 微调过程中的 PSNR 曲线。 由于监督视图有限，仅抖动视图并不能提高 L4GM 的重建质量，因为模型往往会过度拟合一组狭窄的视图，从而导致训练不稳定和 PSNR 较低。shows the PSNR curves during the finetuning of L4GM on MVOIK-4D. With limited supervision views, jittered views alone do not improve the reconstruction quality of L4GM, as the model tends to overfit to a narrow set of viewpoints, which leads to unstable training and lower PSNR.

增加监督视图的数量可以提高 L4GM 的性能。 随机采样的视图提供更强的几何多样性和更好的空间覆盖，从而实现更稳定的优化和更高的重建精度。 这凸显了更强的多视图监督的重要性以及 HAT-4D 对于动态 4D 生成的意义。Increasing the number of supervision views improves the performance of L4GM. Randomly sampled views provide stronger geometric diversity and better spatial coverage, enabling more stable optimization and higher reconstruction accuracy. This highlights the importance of stronger multi-view supervision and the meaning of HAT-4D for dynamic 4D generation.

6 结论Conclusion

我们呈现We presentHAT-4D，一个用于从单目视频重建动态 4D 对象交互的代理框架。 通过集成多级人机交互反馈，HAT-4D 改进了 3D 对象生成、空间合成和 4D 动态传播，提高了物理合理性和时间一致性。 我们还介绍, an agentic framework for reconstructing dynamic 4D object interactions from monocular videos. By integrating multi-level human-in-the-loop feedback, HAT-4D refines 3D object generation, spatial composition, and 4D dynamic propagation, improving physical plausibility and temporal consistency. We also introduceMVOIK-4D，一个基准, a benchmark with112个场景112 scenes, 77 项任务77 tasks, 39个互动类别39 interaction categories, 和, and15个物体变形类别15 object deformation categories，以及生成质量、交互一致性和长期记忆稳定性的多维评估协议。, together with a multi-dimensional evaluation protocol for generation quality, interaction consistency, and long-term memory stability.

然而，如图所示。However, as shown in Fig.7，HAT-4D 仍然面临复杂的柔性变形和快速非刚性运动的挑战，其中不规则的几何形状和运动模糊降低了基于 SAM3D 的几何重建性能。性能还取决于底层VLM的推理能力和推理效率。 未来的工作将探索改进的时间对应、变形建模、VLM 微调以及从单目视频生成更具可扩展性的 4D 交互数据。 我们希望 HAT-4D 和 MVOIK-4D 能够支持对象交互理解、4D 生成和机器人感知方面的研究。, HAT-4D remains challenged by complex flexible deformation and fast non-rigid motion, where irregular geometry and motion blur degrade SAM3D-based geometry reconstruction. Performance also depends on the reasoning capability and inference efficiency of the underlying VLM. Future work will explore improved temporal correspondence, deformation modeling, VLM fine-tuning, and more scalable 4D interaction data generation from monocular videos. We hope HAT-4D and MVOIK-4D will support research in object interaction understanding, 4D generation, and robotic perception.

7.1 管道细节Detail of the Pipeline

图Figure8说明了 HAT-4D 的详细流程。 给定单目视频，系统首先执行对象交互理解。 通过每八帧采样一帧来对输入视频进行时间下采样。 基于这些框架，交互理解代理提取illustrates the detailed pipeline of HAT-4D. Given a monocular video, the system first performs object interaction understanding. The input video is temporally downsampled by sampling one frame every eight frames. Based on these frames, an interaction understanding agent extracts an交互知识图（IKG）Interaction Knowledge Graph (IKG)，它描述了对象， 他们的身份，以及视频中发生的互动事件。, which describes the objects, their identities, and the interaction events occurring in the video.

以 IKG 为条件，Conditioned on the IKG, the3D 对象生成代理3D Object Generation Agent重建 使用 SAM3D 的单个对象reconstructs individual objects using the SAM3D[sam3d]运营商。 每个对象都表示为一组 3D 高斯。 对象重建后，operator. Each object is represented as a set of 3D Gaussians. After object reconstruction, the3D 对象组合代理3D Object Composition Agent将这些对象放置到共享场景中并细化它们的空间关系 使用姿势优化模块来维持物理上合理的交互。places these objects into a shared scene and refines their spatial relations using a pose optimization module to maintain physically plausible interactions.

一旦构建了静态 3D 场景，系统就会进行渲染 合成场景的多视图图像。 这些渲染的图像用作 4D 传播算子。Once the static 3D scene is constructed, the system renders multi-view images of the composed scene. These rendered images serve as the input primitives for the 4D propagation operator.

为了保持时间一致性，To maintain temporal consistency, a关键记忆选择代理Key Memory Selection Agent选择代表性帧并存储其相应的 3D 高斯 存储库中的状态。 这些内存条目作为后续的参考 4D 传播过程。selects representative frames and stores their corresponding 3D Gaussian states in a memory bank. These memory entries serve as references during the subsequent 4D propagation process.

如果生成的结果通过评估，则将其添加到 存储体通过密钥存储选择代理来更新 参考状态。 否则，结果将被视为失败案例并通过以下方式进行细化： 的If the generated result passes the evaluation, it is added to the memory bank through the Key Memory Selection Agent to update the reference states. The corrected objects are then reprocessed by the3D 对象生成和组合代理3D Object Generation and Composition Agents，并且管道仍在继续。, and the pipeline continues.

10.4 基于VLM的交互质量评估VLM-based Interaction Quality Evaluation

CLIP、LPIPS、FVD等感知指标主要衡量视觉 相似性但无法直接评估对象交互是否服从 物理上合理的行为。 为了评估重建相互作用的物理正确性， 我们引入了基于 VLM 的评估协议。Perceptual metrics such as CLIP, LPIPS, and FVD mainly measure visual similarity but cannot directly assess whether object interactions obey physically plausible behavior. To evaluate the physical correctness of reconstructed interactions, we introduce an VLM-based evaluation protocol.

给定一个参考视频和四个生成的视频 重建场景，评估者首先分析参考 交互并构建简化的物理交互模型。 然后将生成的视频与该模型进行比较以评估 重建的相互作用是否遵循物理一致性 行为。Given a reference video and four generated videos rendered from the reconstructed scene, the evaluator first analyzes the reference interaction and builds a simplified physical interaction model. The generated videos are then compared with this model to evaluate whether the reconstructed interaction follows physically consistent behavior.

评估侧重于两个互补的方面：The evaluation focuses on two complementary aspects:互动关系质量interaction relation quality和and相互作用变形质量interaction deformation quality.

交互关系质量Interaction Relation Quality。 交互关系质量衡量空间关系是否 物体之间的因果相互作用在物理上是一致的。 具体来说，评估者检查 是否产生交互 满足以下约束：. Interaction Relation Quality measures whether the spatial relationships and causal interactions between objects are physically consistent. Specifically, the evaluator examines whether the generated interaction satisfies the following constraints:

  • •

    交互对象之间的正确接触位置correct contact locations between interacting objects

  • •

    交互事件的正确时间顺序correct temporal ordering of interaction events

  • •

    物理上合理的相对运动physically plausible relative motion

  • •

    不存在不切实际的相互渗透absence of unrealistic interpenetration

每个生成的视频都会收到一个Each generated video receives an互动得分interaction score在范围内in the range[0,10][0,10].

交互变形质量。Interaction Deformation Quality.交互变形质量评估物体形状是否发生变化 由相互作用引起的遵循物理上合理的变形模式。 评估重点是：Interaction Deformation Quality evaluates whether object shape changes caused by interactions follow physically plausible deformation patterns. The evaluation focuses on:

  • •

    变形过程中的形状连续性shape continuity during deformation

  • •

    体积保存volume preservation

  • •

    真实的弯曲、切割或压缩realistic bending, cutting, or compression

  • •

    没有严重的几何伪影absence of severe geometric artifacts

每个生成的视频都会收到一个Each generated video receives a变形分数deformation score在范围内in the range[0,10][0,10].

具体来说，我们使用Qwen3-VL-Instruct-235B-A22B作为视觉语言模型进行评估和分析。 详细的评估提示在第 2 节中提供。Specifically, we use Qwen3-VL-Instruct-235B-A22B as the Vision-Language Model for evaluation and analysis. The detailed evaluation prompt is provided in Sec.14.

此外，在第二节中。Furthermore, in Sec.11我们分析了基于 VLM 的评估结果与人类判断之间的相关性，证明了所提出的基于 VLM 的交互质量评估的可靠性。we analyze the correlation between the VLM-based evaluation results and human judgments, demonstrating the reliability of the proposed VLM-based Interaction Quality Evaluation.

11.2 交互指标Interaction Metric

我们随机抽取了数据集的三分之一，并要求两名人类评估者根据交互对象位置的合理性和交互对象变形的合理性对不同模型的输出进行独立排名。We randomly sampled one-third of the dataset and asked two human evaluators to independently rank the outputs of different models in terms of plausibility of interacting object positions, and plausibility of interacting object deformations.

然后，我们计算了所提出的交互指标和人类评分之间的斯皮尔曼等级相关系数（SRCC）。如表所示。We then computed the Spearman Rank Correlation Coefficient (SRCC) between the proposed interaction metrics and the human ratings. As shown in Table.5，结果表明，我们的交互指标在特定评估维度下的排名中与人类判断表现出很强的排名相关性。这进一步验证了我们的指标与人类感知之间的紧密一致性，并确认了交互指标的有效性。, the results demonstrate that our interaction metrics exhibit strong rank correlation with human judgments in rankings under specific evaluation dimensions. This further verifies the strong alignment between our metrics and human perception and confirms the effectiveness of the interaction metrics.

13 多技能代理详细提示Detailed Prompts of Multi-Skill Agent

13.1 视频理解代理Video Understanding Aegnt

要理解包含复杂对象交互的长单眼视频， 我们设计了分层视频理解策略。 代理首先执行To understand long monocular videos containing complex object interactions, we design a hierarchical video understanding strategy. The agent first performs段级推理segment-level reasoning然后 进行and then conducts全球聚合global aggregation以获得一致的交互表示。to obtain a consistent interaction representation.

段级理解。Segment-level Understanding.给定一个长视频序列，我们首先将其分为几个短时间段。 对于每个片段，视觉语言模型 (VLM) 分析视觉内容 并提取有关的结构化信息 对象、它们的相互作用以及它们的相对空间关系。 代理不是预测数字 6DoF 姿势，而是输出Given a long video sequence, we first divide it into several short temporal segments. For each segment, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) analyzes the visual content and extracts structured information about the objects, their interactions, and their relative spatial relationships. Instead of predicting numerical 6DoF poses, the agent outputs a符号时间场景图symbolic temporal scene graph描述对象身份， 交互事件和定性空间关系 （例如，左/右、上/下、前/后）。 这种设计提高了严重遮挡和视点模糊情况下的鲁棒性。that describes object identities, interaction events, and qualitative spatial relations (e.g., left/right, above/below, front/behind). This design improves robustness under severe occlusion and viewpoint ambiguity.

带内存的全局聚合。Global Aggregation With Memory.处理完所有段后，代理聚合段级结果 转化为全局场景表示。 在此步骤中，模型跨段合并对象身份， 解决时间冲突，并保持一致的符号约束 空间关系和物体相互作用。 使用内存机制来存储关键关系和约束， 这有助于保持整个视频的交互一致性。After processing all segments, the agent aggregates the segment-level results into a global scene representation. During this step, the model merges object identities across segments, resolves temporal conflicts, and maintains consistent symbolic constraints on spatial relations and object interactions. A memory mechanism is used to store key relations and constraints, which helps preserve interaction consistency throughout the entire video.

深度订购完成。Depth Ordering Completion.单目视频经常遭受深度模糊的困扰， 这可能会导致空间推理不一致。 为了解决这个问题，我们引入一个Monocular videos often suffer from depth ambiguity, which may lead to inconsistent spatial reasoning. To address this issue, we introduce a深度顺序完成模块depth-order completion module。 基于视觉证据和聚合场景图， VLM 预测对象随时间变化的深度排序 沿着相机观察方向。 结果表示为定性深度时间线，表明 不同时间间隔内对象的相对从前到后排序。. Based on the visual evidence and the aggregated scene graph, the VLM predicts a temporally varying depth ordering of objects along the camera viewing direction. The result is expressed as a qualitative depth timeline that indicates the relative front-to-back ordering of objects during different time intervals.

视频理解代理的最终输出是结构化的The final output of the Video Understanding Agent is a structured交互对象知识Interactive Object Knowledge代表， 其中包括对象、交互事件、时间阶段、 符号空间关系和深度排序时间线。 这种表示为下游提供了可靠的基础 3D 重建和 4D 交互生成模块。representation, which includes objects, interaction events, temporal phases, symbolic spatial relations, and depth ordering timelines. This representation provides a reliable foundation for the downstream 3D reconstruction and 4D interaction generation modules.

每个阶段使用的详细提示如下所示。The detailed prompts used in each stage are shown below.

13.2 物体检测代理Object Detection Agent

基于交互式对象知识（IKG）表示 视频理解代理，目标检测代理定位目标对象 在输入帧中并生成像素级分割掩模。Based on the Interactive Object Knowledge (IKG) representation produced by the Video Understanding Agent, the Object Detection Agent localizes target objects in the input frames and generates pixel-level segmentation masks.

代理首先分析对象语义和视觉上下文以生成 点提示输入分段任意模型 (SAM)。 这些提示包括两个积极点（表明属于 目标对象）和负点（表示必须排除的区域）。The agent first analyzes the object semantics and visual context to generate point prompts for the Segment Anything Model (SAM). These prompts include both positive points (indicating regions that belong to the target object) and negative points (indicating regions that must be excluded).

然后使用生成的点来生成初始分割掩模。 为了提高分割质量，代理迭代评估掩模并 必要时细化点提示。 采用视觉语言模型（VLM）来分析分割结果， 检测潜在的错误，例如丢失的对象部分或错误包含的区域， 并为下一轮积分规划提供结构化反馈。The generated points are then used to produce an initial segmentation mask. To improve segmentation quality, the agent iteratively evaluates the mask and refines the point prompts when necessary. A Vision-Language Model (VLM) is employed to analyze segmentation results, detect potential errors such as missing object parts or wrongly included regions, and provide structured feedback for the next round of point planning.

这个迭代过程持续进行，直到掩模准确地捕获目标 对象，同时排除所有非目标对象。 最终输出是一个可靠的像素级对象掩模，用作 随后的 3D 重建阶段。This iterative process continues until the mask accurately captures the target object while excluding all non-target objects. The final output is a reliable pixel-level object mask that serves as input for the subsequent 3D reconstruction stage.

姿势调整代理利用交互式对象知识 (IKG) 表示和当前帧来进一步分析沿相机观看方向的深度排序。 它首先推断目标对象和已生成的对象之间的先前深度排序。 基于这种推断的顺序，代理调整新生成的对象和现有对象之间的相对空间配置，以确保物理上合理的放置。 本模块中使用的提示如下所示。The Pose Adjustment Agent leverages the Interactive Object Knowledge (IKG) representation together with the current frame to further analyze the depth ordering along the camera viewing direction. It first infers a prior depth ordering among the target object and the already generated objects. Based on this inferred ordering, the agent adjusts the relative spatial configuration between the newly generated object and the existing objects to ensure physically plausible placement. The prompts used in this module are presented below.

13.3 4D 验证器和内存选择代理4D Validator and Memory Select Agent

随着4D传播模块不断生成新的3D资产，4D验证器代理从多个角度分析生成的结果，包括交互重建质量和交互引起的变形质量。 如果生成的结果通过验证标准，它将由内存选择代理进一步处理，决定当前结果是否应该存储在内存库中。 下面给出了相应的提示。As the 4D Propagation Module continuously generates new 3D assets, the 4D Validator Agent analyzes the generated results from multiple perspectives, including interaction reconstruction quality and interaction-induced deformation quality. If the generated result passes the validation criteria, it will be further processed by the Memory Selection Agent, which determines whether the current result should be stored in the Memory Bank.
